outline.title: Serbian AI Tutor
outline.summary: Beta Launch Audit Report - Status: 50-60% Ready for Beta Launch. Date: November 8, 2025. Prepared by Manus AI Audit.

outline.title: Executive Summary
outline.summary: Solid foundation with excellent user management, authentication, and learning features. Critical gaps in subscription, payment, and plan access control. Timeline: 2-3 weeks with 2 developers needed before Beta launch.
outline.image_plan: /home/ubuntu/upload/search_images/FJ4rGlXzEkpj.jpg - Image 2 is an 'Internal Audit Report & Recommendations' template, which visually supports the 'Executive Summary' and the critical gaps/achievements listed.

outline.title: Recent Improvements
outline.summary: Chat feature enhancements including fixed title generation (first 12 characters of user message) and bulk delete functionality for empty chats. Significantly improved user experience and session organization.

outline.title: Component Status - Ready
outline.summary: Complete components: User Management, Authentication, Learning Features, Gamification, Beta Testing System, and Chat Features (recently enhanced).
outline.image_plan: /home/ubuntu/upload/search_images/6iKvfl8E6zK6.jpg - Image 3 is a 'Yearly Internal Quality Audit Report' template with a clear table structure, which visually complements the 'Component Status Overview' table.

outline.title: Component Status - Missing
outline.summary: Critical missing components: Subscription Management (40-60 hrs), Payment Processing (30-40 hrs), User Plan Limits (20-30 hrs), Email Automation, Admin Dashboard, and Security & Compliance.

outline.title: Critical Path - Phase 1
outline.summary: Foundation phase (Week 1): Subscription Management, Payment Processing, User Plan Limits. Total effort: 100-130 hours. Must be completed before Beta launch.
outline.image_plan: /home/ubuntu/upload/search_images/YD4eN59NArR5.jpg - Image 6 is a 'Three Months Software Developer Roadmap with Milestones', which is highly relevant to the 'Critical Path - Phase 1' and the detailed effort estimates.

outline.title: Critical Path - Phase 2
outline.summary: Enhancement phase (Week 2): Email Automation, Admin Dashboard, Security & Compliance. Total effort: 80-110 hours. Parallel work with Phase 1 possible.
outline.image_plan: /home/ubuntu/upload/search_images/MWGJwwGX5niR.jpg - Image 5 is a 'Software Roadmap Template', which visually supports the 'Critical Path - Phase 2' and the continued planning/effort estimation.

outline.title: Implementation Priority Matrix
outline.summary: High Impact + High Effort: Subscription, Payment, Email. High Impact + Medium Effort: Plan Limits, Admin Dashboard, Security. Medium Impact + Low Effort: Analytics.
outline.image_plan: /home/ubuntu/upload/search_images/tkxayDldvJom.jpg - Image 1 is an 'SEO Audit Report' with sections like 'Details' and 'Action Plan', which visually supports the concept of prioritizing tasks in the 'Implementation Priority Matrix'.

outline.title: Timeline & Resource Estimates
outline.summary: Single Developer: 5-7 weeks, €11-21K. Two Developers (recommended): 2.5-3.5 weeks, €11-21K. MVP Option: 2-3 weeks, €4.5-9.75K.

outline.title: Go/No-Go Decision Matrix
outline.summary: Ready to Launch: User Management, Authentication, Learning Features, Gamification, Beta Testing, Chat Features. NOT Ready: Subscription, Payment, Plan Limits, Email, Admin Dashboard, Security.
outline.image_plan: /home/ubuntu/upload/search_images/G3Fvtaeoqg8l.png - Image 7 is a 'Project Closeout Checklist Template', which visually represents the concept of a 'Go/No-Go Decision Matrix' and the items that are ready/not ready.

outline.title: Immediate Actions
outline.summary: This week priorities: Prioritize critical components, allocate 2 developers, start Stripe setup, create subscription database schema, begin email automation planning.

outline.title: Short-term Roadmap
outline.summary: Week 1: Subscription, Payment, Plan Limits. Week 2: Email Automation, Admin Dashboard, Security. Week 3: Testing, Optimization, Documentation.

outline.title: Risk Assessment - Part 1
outline.summary: First three critical risks with high impact: Payment Processing Delays (Critical), Database Performance Issues (Critical), and Subscription Edge Cases (Critical). Each risk includes impact/probability metrics and mitigation strategies. Focus on technical infrastructure risks.

outline.title: Risk Assessment - Part 2
outline.summary: Remaining three risks: Email Delivery Failures (Medium), Security Vulnerabilities (Critical), and User Confusion with Plans (Medium). Includes risk management approach summary explaining how to prioritize high-impact risks, implement mitigation strategies, and establish monitoring for production issues.

outline.title: Success Metrics
outline.summary: Technical checklist: Authentication, learning content, chat system, payment system, subscription system, plan access control. Business checklist: Pricing, testing, admin operations, legal docs, support.

outline.title: Conclusion
outline.summary: Strong foundation ready for Beta. Recent chat improvements enhance user experience. Critical business logic must be implemented. 2-3 weeks with 2 developers to completion.

outline.title: Next Steps - Phase 1
outline.summary: First three critical action items for Beta launch: Approve implementation plan, confirm resource allocation, and start Phase 1 implementation. Includes timeline and descriptions for each step.

outline.title: Next Steps - Phase 2 & Launch
outline.summary: Remaining three action items: Weekly check-ins and progress reviews, target Beta launch in 2-3 weeks, and full testing & legal review. Includes call-to-action section and contact information for questions.

outline.title: Questions & Discussion
outline.summary: Contact development team for questions. Review full audit report for details. Schedule next meeting for progress review and blocker resolution.
